summary.text: Ronald Whitfield, a Republican, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Texas's 18th District, a heavily Democratic Houston-area district, to Rep. Christian Menefee.
He first appeared on the ballot as a Republican candidate in the November 2025 special election for the seat and won the March 2026 Republican primary.
Little other biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Whitfield ran as a Republican in the November 4, 2025 special election for Texas's 18th District, receiving 1.5% of the vote in a field of more than a dozen candidates.
He won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for the district over Elizabeth Vences, 55.1% to 44.9%.
He received 14.0% of the vote to Christian Menefee's 86.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
